_comment: BluePilot Visuals Settings - Merged from SunnyPilot VisualsPanel + existing BP Visuals menu

controls.title: Enhanced Onroad UI
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Enable enhanced lane lines, road edges, and path rendering with glow effects and curve smoothing.

controls.title: 自定义模型路径颜色
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 自定义驾驶路径叠加层的颜色

controls.title: Show Animated Steer Angle Icon
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Animates Comma icon based on steering angle.

controls.title: 显示制动状态
controls.desc:
[BluePilot] 按下制动时，将速度颜色变为红色。
（此设置目前仅在F150上测试过。）

controls.title: Show Blind Spot Warnings
controls.desc: Enabling this will display warnings when a vehicle is detected in your blind spot as long as your car has BSM supported.

controls.title: Show Stop Indicator Overlay
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays a stop indicator overlay when it detects a stop point.

controls.title: 低速时显示广角摄像头
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 低速时显示广角摄像头。

controls.title: 启用特斯拉彩虹模式
controls.desc:
在模型想要行驶的路径上显示美丽的彩虹效果。
它不会以任何方式影响驾驶。

controls.title: Display Road Name
controls.desc: Displays the name of the road the car is traveling on. The OpenStreetMap database of the location must be downloaded from the OSM panel to fetch the road name.

controls.title: Speedometer: Always Display True Speed
controls.desc: Always display the true vehicle current speed from wheel speed sensors.

controls.title: Speedometer: Hide from Onroad Screen
controls.desc: When enabled, the speedometer on the onroad screen is not displayed.

controls.title: Display Turn Signals
controls.desc: When enabled, visual turn indicators are drawn on the HUD.

controls.title: Show Radar Lead Vehicle Overlay
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays radar data lead vehicle overlay.

controls.title: 雷达前车叠加层大小
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 调整雷达前车叠加层的大小

allConditionsTrue.reason: 需要启用雷达前车叠加层

controls.title: 显示混合动力电动数据叠加层
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 显示混合动力电动车辆数据。

allConditionsTrue.reason: Vehicle does not support hybrid electric data

controls.title: 显示混合动力电池数据叠加层
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 显示混合动力电池数据。

allConditionsTrue.reason: 需要启用混合动力电动数据叠加层
车辆不支持混合动力电动数据
车辆不支持混合动力电池数据

controls.title: 混合动力驱动仪表大小
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 调整混合动力驱动仪表的大小

allConditionsTrue.reason: 需要启用混合动力电动数据叠加层

controls.title: 显示G力仪表
controls.desc: [BluePilot] 行驶时显示G力仪表。
controls._comment: DISABLED: G-Force meter disabled for performance/consistency issues

controls.title: Enable Standstill Timer
controls.desc: Show a timer on the HUD when the car is at a standstill.

controls.title: Enable BluePilot Alert UI
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Enable BluePilot visual alert design with modern styling, smooth animations, and enhanced readability.

controls.title: 绿灯警报（Beta）
controls.desc:
当您等待的交通灯变绿且您前方没有车辆时，将播放提示音和屏幕警报。

注意：此提示音仅设计为通知。驾驶员有责任观察周围环境并做出相应决定。

controls.title: 前车起步警报（Beta）
controls.desc:
当您停车时，前车开始移动时将播放提示音和屏幕警报。

注意：此提示音仅设计为通知。驾驶员有责任观察周围环境并做出相应决定。

controls.title: 在V形标志下方显示指标
controls.desc: 在跟踪前车的V形标志下方显示有用指标（仅适用于具有openpilot纵向控制的车辆）。

descriptions.default: 在跟踪前车的V形标志下方显示有用指标（仅适用于具有openpilot纵向控制的车辆）。
descriptions.offroad: 启动车辆以检查车辆兼容性。
descriptions.noLong: 此功能需要openpilot纵向控制可用。

allConditionsTrue.reason: 启动车辆以启用此设置

controls.title: 开发者UI
controls.desc: 显示来自各种来源的实时参数和指标。
